data.title: 篝之雾枝 · 月夜落地窗前的交颈缠绵
data.description: 巨大哥特式拱窗外是一轮硕大的圆月。真丝睡袍完全敞开滑落在脚踝处，雾枝双手环抱住对方的脖颈，双腿紧紧盘在腰间，眼底带着被彻底征服的迷离与无尽的依恋。
data.location: tower ballroom before towering stone arched window framing an enormous luminous full moon
data.action: legs wrapped firmly around partner waist, arms hooked around his neck during deep kiss, red silk robe pooled on floor baring pale porcelain curves
data.lighting: magnificent silver full moon backlighting their intertwined silhouette with ethereal silver glow
data.mood: transcendent immortal romance, breathtaking celestial intimacy, total everlasting devotion
data.promptProse: Embracing before an immense full moon window, naked Kirie wraps her legs around partner in a deep, passionate, moonlit lovers kiss.
